name: Kazami Sora
source:
Sora works at Saika Girls' School as a temporary school nurse and counselor. Despite his lack of certification, he is a skilled medical professional.

Besides the health expertise, Sora has solid spiritual senses; he can detect the presence of souls. Relying on these visions, he travels as an Okuribito* to send souls to the afterlife.
Unfortunately, he has a terrible sense of direction and gets lost easily.

Sora belongs to a school of Okuribito called Mutori and is the master of Kotodama (spirits language).

*Okuribito (送り人; lit. sender) is a title for those whose profession is to send souls back to the afterlife.
The existence of Okuribito is unknown to the general public. They are, however, considered to be national civil servants.

[Translated from the [url=https://citrus-soft.net/product/hokejyo/character.html]official website[/url]]
